physics-killer-01.goal: 深入分析Properties of Magnets and Magnetic Interactions的原理，根據給定條件得出正確結論。
physics-killer-01.material: 在無摩擦的雲霄飛車軌道上,物體從高度$50\,\mathrm{m}$的A點由靜止出發。軌道上三個位置的高度如表所示。B點:$45\,\mathrm{m}$,C點:$30\,\mathrm{m}$,D點:$5\,\mathrm{m}$。忽略空氣阻力,且$g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$時,(C點的速率)是(B點的速率)的幾倍,以及D點的速率,依序配對正確的是哪一項?
physics-killer-01.thinking.0: Properties of Magnets and Magnetic Interactions
physics-killer-01.prereq.0: E1 Physics 前置學習概念
physics-killer-01.s.s1.prompt: 在無摩擦的雲霄飛車軌道上,物體從高度$50\,\mathrm{m}$的A點由靜止出發。軌道上三個位置的高度如表所示。B點:$45\,\mathrm{m}$,C點:$30\,\mathrm{m}$,D點:$5\,\mathrm{m}$。忽略空氣阻力,且$g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$時,(C點的速率)是(B點的速率)的幾倍,以及D點的速率,依序配對正確的是哪一項?
physics-killer-01.s.s1.explain: 因為在A點為靜止狀態,所以由$mgh_A=\frac12mv^2+mgh$得$v=\sqrt{2g(h_A-h)}$。$v_B=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot5}=10$,$v_C=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot20}=20$,$v_D=\sqrt{2\cdot10\cdot45}=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$。因此$v_C/v_B=2$倍,$v_D=30\,\mathrm{m/s}$。速率不與下降的高度成正比,而是與$\sqrt{\Delta h}$成正比(錯誤選項①);若把D點的高度$5\,\mathrm{m}$誤當成下降的高度,會得到$10\,\mathrm{m/s}$(錯誤選項③);漏掉$\frac12$則會得到$\sqrt{10\cdot45}\approx21\,\mathrm{m/s}$(錯誤選項④)。
physics-killer-01.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-01.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
physics-killer-01.s.s1.hint.0: 力學能守恆:$mg(h_A-h)=\frac12mv^2$,即$v=\sqrt{2g\,\Delta h}$($\Delta h$為從A點下降的高度)。
physics-killer-01.s.s2.hint.0: Recall the cause-effect relationships established in the first step.
physics-killer-01.s.s2.o.o0: System utilizing the principles to maximize efficiency and safety
